title: Artifact store
responsibility: Persists one artifact per file, resolves the content root, and serialises every read-modify-write so concurrent writers cannot destroy each other.
notes: ⚠️ IT NOW OWNS THE PROJECT ROOT AS WELL AS THE CONTENT ROOT (TSK-0025). `projectRootCandidate()` and `resolveProjectRoot()` sit beside their content-root counterparts because the project root is DERIVED from the content root — `dirname(contentRoot)`, never `<toolRoot>/..` — and putting the derivation anywhere else would create the second path rule #70 exists to prevent. The two candidates agree in a normal consumer install and diverge under PLANNING_CONTENT_DIR, which is exactly where a caller joining its own path would go wrong quietly.
